import os

project_root = "/tmp/run-206af2fd/gars/projects/run-206af2fd"

var_exp = pca.explained_variance_ratio_

print(f"  PC1 variance explained: {var_exp[0]:.2%}")
print(f"  PC2 variance explained: {var_exp[1]:.2%}")

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

condition_colors = {'untreated': '#1f77b4', 'treated': '#d62728'}
colors = [condition_colors[c] for c in conditions]

plt.ylabel(f'PC2 ({var_exp[1]:.1%} variance explained)')
plt.title('PCA of RNA-seq Samples by Condition')
plt.legend(title='Condition', frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=True)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()

2	"""The workspace's batch executor, as a setting rather than a spelling (decision 0039).
3	
4	GARS submits real work to a managed scheduler and never runs it in the current process
5	(decision 0027). That ruling is scheduler-agnostic; only its spelling was Slurm-coupled --
6	`sbatch` lived in generated bytes and in contract prose, so a site without Slurm could not
7	run GARS at all.
8	
9	This module is the one door. It reads `_config/executor.yaml` from the project and answers
10	three questions:
11	
12	    header(...)          the directives block a generated submit.sh opens with
13	    submit(script)       the argv that hands that script to the scheduler -> a job id
14	    status(job_id)       the argv that asks after it -> PENDING | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED
15	
16	No descriptor file, or `name: slurm`, means the built-in Slurm descriptor, whose bytes are
17	identical to what this system generated before the seam existed (pinned by a golden-bytes
18	test). A cluster that upgrades GARS notices nothing.
19	
20	The built-in `local` backend runs the generated script under `nohup`-style detachment and
21	reports the PID as the job id. It exists so the deterministic core can exercise a real
22	submit -> status -> completion walk with no cluster at all; it is POSIX-only, like every
23	other assumption this system already makes, and it is NOT a venue for analyses -- stage 03's
24	venue gate is unchanged.
25	
26	Runs on stock python 3.6.8, stdlib only, like every `_system/` helper.
27	"""

30	import json
31	import os
32	import re
33	import subprocess
